fields.name: SqlShardSets
fields.contract: SqlShardSets is the library facade for SQL shard sets configured through SqlShardConnectionOptions. Constructing SqlShardSets binds shard-set access to the supplied SQL shard-connection configuration and SQL global-properties options, and it hard-wires a new SqlClient DataProviderServiceFactory as its data-provider services directly in the constructor rather than accepting one as a constructor parameter or resolving it from the dependency-injection container — every SqlShardSets instance is bound to the SqlClient provider regardless of what else is registered.
